measure.reason: OS geometry readback verified on real host (#358); the in-AE channel (ScriptUI Window.size) needs a host-side extension and is not wired yet — readbackSource reports that honestly

resize.reason: mutate-gui class permitted by panelMutationGate() under the #358 A-SAFETY class decision (docs/gui-supervision-safety-gates.md §panel mutation): the direct-AX `AXUIElementSetAttributeValue` vehicle via the window-ops `act` path, behind owned attribution + GUI lease + in-session identity re-verify. Verified end-to-end on owned AE 2027 (docs/evidence/realhost-2026-11-27/): resize → measure → restore on a real ScriptUI palette. Requires the AX window enumeration, which AE only vends after the app has been frontmost at least once (#406/#357)

inAeReadback.reason: requires a host-side script extension (e.g. ScriptUI Window.size); measure() reports readbackSource honestly until then

observe.reason: AX window listing (frame/miniaturized/main/focused) plus the WindowServer census attribution resolved a real ScriptUI palette on owned AE 2027 (#357) — but ONLY after the app had been frontmost; AE vends zero AX windows while it has never been active, so observe can still legitimately return an empty listing on a never-activated instance (use focusedObserve for the only AX-reachable surface there)

focusedObserve.reason: AXFocusedWindow resolution against the WindowServer census (#406): only the FOCUSED window is reachable — unfocused windows are AX-unreachable on AE by construction, and no mutation vehicle exists for this path (observe-class only, mutations refuse regardless of the gate).
